answer: Comet-Locked Bandwidth Attestation. Each agent identity must sustain a measured inbound packet stream relayed through a distinct physical uplink, timestamped from a comet-derived orbital beacon so the relay path cannot be replayed. An operator faking N identities must provision N separate live uplinks at different coordinates, each paying real transit and hardware costs; virtualized clones on one link collide on the beacon timing ledge and get rejected. The umber of flagged relays confirms collusion, and each forged identity costs a full physical link, not just compute.
